title: 1st Sitting of Second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/1/2/2026).
From the Speaker's desk: as the Deputy Speaker of Parliament has resigned, the election of a member to that post under Article 82(c) of the Constitution.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The first sitting of the session was scheduled to elect a new Deputy Speaker after the previous one resigned.
